content.short: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol on TON providing users with yield-bearing USDe savings.
content.description: Ethena is a groundbreaking synthetic dollar protocol that has partnered with the TON Foundation to bring its stablecoin, USDe, to the Telegram ecosystem. Known as tsUSDe on the TON network, it provides users with a way to access dollar-denominated savings and earn on-chain yield directly within their Telegram wallets. Ethena maintains its peg through a sophisticated delta-neutral strategy, hedging staked assets to provide stability without relying on traditional banking reserves. It is a vital tool for decentralized finance, offering accessible yield to millions of global users.
